src/app/sentinel/_py/model_anomaly.py.name: Unusual-behaviour detector
src/app/sentinel/_py/model_anomaly.py.description: Cleans the training data, learns what normal agents look like, scores how unusual an agent is and places its dot on the map.

src/app/sentinel/_py/model_supervised.py.name: Known-attack detector
src/app/sentinel/_py/model_supervised.py.description: Learns the four known attack types from labelled examples and names which one an agent looks like, with the reasons.

src/app/sentinel/_py/prompt_guard.py.name: Prompt Guard
src/app/sentinel/_py/prompt_guard.py.description: Reads message text and scores how likely it hides an instruction for another agent; trained on public data and tested on a different set.
